candidate_relations.reason: The clinical picture—vegetating plaques, pustules, keloidal facial lesions, microabscesses with eosinophils, epidermal hyperplasia, and negative PAS—fits pyoderma vegetans. Pyoderma gangrenosum classically presents with undermined ulcers and pathergy, not vegetating/keloidal plaques, and its histology does not typically feature prominent eosinophilia or pseudoepitheliomatous hyperplasia as defining features. C001 names an incompatible subtype (gangrenosum) within the pyoderma family.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Pyoderma gangrenosum is a distinct neutrophilic dermatosis with different morphology and histopathology from pyoderma vegetans; pseudoepitheliomatous hyperplasia is a histologic finding shared with pyoderma vegetans but does not define pyoderma gangrenosum

case_quality_flags: Negative PAS and absence of granulomas help exclude deep fungal infection and tuberculosis verrucosa cutis, supporting pyoderma vegetans
HIV negativity noted, relevant given age and extensive disease
